name: param_priority_classification
content: Classify this parameter for progressive elicitation:
- Critical: Security (passwords, tokens), authentication, irreversible actions (delete, destroy)
- PreExecution: Important context (paths, files, URLs, targets)
- Inferrable: Can be determined from context (dates, usernames, formats)
- Auto: Let system decide based on priority
